title: Why I'll get to AI eventually is the most expensive career decision

passages.text: Not collapsing as in destroying. Collapsing as in compressing—across two dimensions si

The first collapse is horizontal. Engineer, product manager, marketer, analyst, designer, ops lead—these used to be distinct career paths with distinct skill sets. They’re converging—fast—into a single meta-competency: orchestrating AI agents to get work done.
